subject.title: improve(ui): sidebar session selection reads as filled pill instead of accent border

question: Should this protected-label PR wait for directly inspectable visual evidence before merge, or does an owner-provided manual visual check suffice?
rationale: The patch is technically clean, but repository policy requires clear real-behavior proof for user-visible changes and the claimed screenshots are unavailable to this review.

options.title: Require attached screenshots
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted light and dark before-and-after screenshots demonstrate all relevant sidebar row states.

options.title: Accept owner visual check
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept responsibility for the visual result without a public artifact.

recommendation.title: Require attached screenshots
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted light and dark before-and-after screenshots demonstrate all relevant sidebar row states.
